notes: Clauses 4.1.2 and 4.19 require an untimed save to instruct all joined members as soon as possible. Clause 4.19.6 delays non-time-constrained members until all time-constrained members are eligible. Clause 4.20 limits each constrained member's Initiate Federate Save to its own Time Advancing state; §8.1.7 defines that interval. Because §8.8.3 forbids a Time Advance Request while a save is in progress, the bounded implementation accepts every constrained member's TAR before starting the untimed save. It then initiates each constrained member while that member remains Time Advancing; the focused tests target requests above initial GALT so no grant can precede these callbacks. The non-time-constrained requester is instructed after all constrained members are eligible. §4.1.3 is explanatory synchronization discussion, not a mapped requirement. The portable C++ TCK passes both callback models; local adapter results are not conformance evidence.
